_comment: Optional server-specific rules for merge-mcp-config.js (--rules). They hold what used to be hard-coded branches of the merge: (1) argsWhenEnvSet - when the named env value of a server is set to a real value (not <CONFIGURE>), make sure its args carry the given sequence (e.g. a tracker server that needs an explicit token-auth flag once a token exists); (2) retiredServers - a local server that a decision retired is removed from the client config, with the reason printed. Rename the example servers; cite the decision that retired a server in its reason.
